releases.name: v0.27.0 — Navigator comes to Desktop
releases.body:
# Navigator comes to Desktop

## Highlights

- Open Navigator in OpenCode Desktop as a native panel or an opt-in mini-window inside the app. Keep your selected session, filters and monitoring when moving between them.
- Use Search Everything, Skills, MCP groups and presets, Quick Actions and customizable toolbar pins in Desktop, alongside the existing TUI interface.
- Configure scope-aware sections, groups, trust and profiles in native Settings. Browse release history, revisit the seven-slide guide and review editable GitHub Bug reports.
- View verified provider/account quotas, link the intended account and confirm banked resets explicitly. Remote sessions never borrow a local provider account.
- Avoid false configuration errors from superseded Desktop refreshes while retaining genuine errors and retry guidance.

## Upgrade notes

- Verified hosts: OpenCode TUI 1.19.5 and 2.2.6; experimental OpenCode Desktop 2.2.6. Browser Web and detached OS windows are not supported targets.
- Desktop loads the GUI from the Navigator package in its global server configuration. A CLI-only entry in `cli.json` does not enable Desktop. See the README's Experimental OpenCode Desktop section before changing configuration shared with OpenCode 1.x.
- Existing private preferences, account bindings, reset attempts and the read-only legacy Todo archive are preserved. Use Reload preferences to import changes saved by another local Navigator instance.
- TUI rounded multiline selections still require the bundled OpenCode Navigator Corners font on the machine displaying the terminal. Install or update it with `opencode-navigator-font`, keep your primary Nerd Font selected, and fully restart the terminal. Without the extra font, disable Multiline corner font or use Text fallback. Desktop does not need terminal fonts.
- Restart OpenCode after updating Navigator to load the new plugin version.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/compare/v0.26.0...v0.27.0

## Highlights

- Subagents use OpenCode 2's native execution-start time for accurate active durations, including children already running when Navigator opens. Missing native timing keeps the observed-duration fallback.
- Interrupted Subagent executions stay marked as Cancelled in Recent.
- Background retries no longer accumulate cancellation listeners, and preferences loading no longer waits indefinitely on recovery markers.

## Upgrade notes

- Supported hosts remain OpenCode **1.19.5** and **2.2.5**. Restart OpenCode after updating Navigator.
- Keep your primary Nerd Font selected and install **OpenCode Navigator Corners** on the machine displaying the terminal for rounded multiline selections. This release does not change the font; existing installations do not need a font update. After installing or updating the font, fully restart the terminal. Text mode and the separate multiline-corner switch remain available.
- Updating the package does not update a pinned local-source installation automatically; use Navigator's confirmed update flow for that installation.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/compare/v0.25.0...v0.26.0

releases.name: v0.25.0 — Native Todo setup and current onboarding
releases.body:
## Highlights

- **Enable native Todo from Navigator.** When OpenCode 2's Todo tool is disabled, use Enable Todo in the section or command palette, choose an existing server configuration, review the flag change, and confirm it. Cancel keeps the file unchanged. Setup preserves unrelated JSONC content and refuses stale file, source, session and workspace previews.
- **A current seven-slide setup guide.** The tour covers native Todo enablement, provider/account allowances, private multi-icon and text-only toolbar pins, About, release history and Bug reports. Permissions and LSP descriptions match the running host's actual capabilities.
- **Short-terminal navigation stays visible.** Long wizard content and section choices scroll with the mouse or PageUp/PageDown while headings and Back/Next/Finish stay in view.

## Upgrade notes

- Supported hosts remain OpenCode **1.19.5** and **2.2.5**. Restart OpenCode after updating Navigator.
- Todo setup changes only the selected server configuration flag. Task edits remain in ordinary chat through the built-in `todowrite` tool; setup does not invoke a model or create task events. An enabled empty list does not offer enablement again.
- Rounded multiline selections in Nerd Font mode require **OpenCode Navigator Corners** alongside your primary Nerd Font on the machine displaying the terminal. See the README installation instructions; restart the terminal after a font installation or update. Text fallback and the multiline-corner switch remain available.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/compare/v0.24.0...v0.25.0

releases.name: v0.24.0 — About, custom toolbar buttons and a steadier sidebar
releases.body:
## Highlights

- **Settings → About** shows running versions, update status and checks, and release notes browsable by version. Reopening the changelog does not consume the first-launch upgrade notice.
- **Editable Bug reports** offer a confirmed send through an already authenticated GitHub CLI and an independent Open in browser action. Reports use the repository's Bug issue type and do not silently collect chat, source paths or logs.
- **Custom toolbar buttons** support zero to three ordered icons and optional single-line text, including text-only buttons. State-specific icons, draft editing, More and wrapping remain available.
- **A steadier sidebar** preserves Quick Action and Limits rows across ordinary updates. Toolbar hover/focus hints no longer push other sections down, and rounded selection backgrounds stay consistent.
- **Current host support** targets OpenCode **1.19.5** and **2.2.5**, preserving the separate adapters and established sidebar behavior.

## Upgrade notes

- Restart OpenCode after updating Navigator. Only the two current host versions above are supported.
- Rounded multiline selections in Nerd Font mode require the additional **OpenCode Navigator Corners** font on the machine displaying the terminal, alongside your primary Nerd Font. See the README installation instructions; restart the terminal after installing or updating a font. Text fallback and the multiline-corner switch remain available.
- Recognized pinned-file installations retain their installation method and scope when updated through Navigator.

## Thanks

Thanks to **@simonklee** for [PR #27](https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/pull/27) and **@avissian** for [PR #32](https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/pull/32). Their fixes were adapted in separately attributed commits.

releases.name: v0.23.0 — Native OpenCode 2.2 integration
releases.body:
## Highlights

- **Current OpenCode hosts:** support OpenCode **1.19.5 and 2.2.0**. Older versions are no longer supported.
- **Live host data:** keep Skills, MCP servers and Subagents current through OpenCode 2's reactive sources. Launch the intended Skill even when different sources have the same name, and preserve Navigator shortcuts and nested-dialog navigation.
- **Console and Go limits:** show applicable Console workspace budgets in USD and Go allowance percentages/reset times through the public host usage API. This source needs no Navigator server plugin; authentication and request failures retain explicit guidance or Retry.
- **Safer pinned updates:** verify that a supported target runtime is available before switching a recognized local snapshot, preserving the previous installation on failure.

## Upgrade notes

- Use the supported OpenCode release for your major line: **1.19.5** or **2.2.0**. The adapters remain separate and share each host's own Solid/OpenTUI runtime.
- Console/Go workspace budgets are separate from provider account balances and session token/cost statistics. Other provider sources retain their existing prerequisites and account guards; banked reset credits still require explicit confirmation.
- Pinned-snapshot verification requires **Bun >=1.3.14 or Node >=26.4.0**. The updater does not install a runtime globally or convert a local-file installation to an npm installation.
- Rounded multiline highlights require the additional **OpenCode Navigator Corners** font on the machine displaying the terminal. Keep your primary Nerd Font selected; follow the [font installation instructions](https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator#install-the-corner-font) and fully restart the terminal after installing it. The font is unchanged in this release; existing installations need no font update.
- See [Host API boundaries](https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/blob/v0.23.0/HOST_API.md) and the shipped [changelog](https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/blob/v0.23.0/CHANGELOG.md) for capability details.
